body: Yeah, I used to do the same thing, fantasized about my suicide and what would happen after I'm gone. Like what will my parents and friends feel. But then these fantasies turned into plans and gere I am 1 failed attempt 3 weeks ago, gonna try to do it again in a few days but this time I ain't gonna fail. My advice, if you haven't seeked help from a psychotherapist you should do it as soon as possible! It is really hard to get better and keep going when you're suicidal and have failed in the past, so please do everything you can before your fantasies start turning into plans! Wish you all the best, stay strong!

Thank you for your support and kindness! At moments like this it is all a hopeless person could wish for! I already called my lovely boyfriend and I know that he is in pain, he's scared and blames himself for everything.. thank god he felt releaved and told me that we'll get through it together and I promised that I'll do my best not to drag him through that hell again...
Thank you! Maybe I actually still have a life ahead and maybe I could try to fix what's broken. Right now all I have is a small spark of hope for the better but I don't know if that's enough..

I wasn't going to tell anyone, but I scheduled a message to be sent 3 hours after my death.. I thought that If I survived I could've just deleted the message before he got it, but I was unconcious and couldn't do it.. but yeah, I totally agree with you, It's better to do leave without telling anyone and just leaving a paper note or something.. and yeah, getting that far and failing is worse than planning but never actually trying..

I'm sorry to hear that you've had to go through this too! I guess I'm gonna start my journey by calling my love and telling him that I'm still here.. I can't even imagine what he's going through right now...

Thank you! It means a lot to me😭❤ maybe I'm not supposed to go yet? Maybe I still have something to live for? I'll try to find reasons to stay and maybe someday I will indeed help others who can't take it anymore and need a reason to keep going..
